summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the election of new Board members and executive officers approved at an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 8, 2026. A new Chairman (Magda Chambriard), Vice-Chairman, CEO (Helcio Tokeshi), CFO (Carlos Brandão), and several other officers were elected. Four prior executives (Roberto Ramos, Felipe Jens, Geraldo Netto, Stefan Lepecki) left their positions. The filing is a routine governance update; no merger, tender, or special transaction is described. Management changes are structural but appear orderly. The terms are internal; no shareholder vote on a deal. Watch for strategic shifts under the new leadership team.
